packaging/build_binary_windows.ps1

PowerShell · Tier B

Invoke the native Windows binary builder from the repository.

Usage

Maintainer build wrapper; end users run the resulting executable. Arguments pass to native_binary_builder.py.

Inputs

SMTO_BUILD_PYTHON or the repository Windows virtual environment, then PATH python as fallback.

Side effects

The builder may download dependencies and write native distribution artifacts according to its requested options.

Cleanup

Returns the builder exit status; artifact and build-cache lifetime belongs to that builder.

@see scripts/native_binary_builder.py
